chapter.title: Preparing files
chapter.p: Before sending a job to print, check that every file meets the printer's specification. Most problems are caught by a preflight check.

ol.li: Images are at least 300 ppi at final size
All fonts are embedded or outlined
Bleed of 3 mm on every edge

section.title: Colour
section.p: Convert RGB images to CMYK using the profile supplied by the printer.
section.note: Spot colours must be named exactly as in the swatch book.

chapter.title: Paper stocks
chapter.blockquote: Choose the stock before the design, not after.
